text:
Predicates:
GenerationTask(x) ::: x is a language generation task.
UnderstandingTask(x) ::: x is a language understanding task.
OutputTextSequence(x) ::: x is the output of a text sequence.
NLPtask(x) ::: x is a natural language processing task.
MachineTranslation(x) ::: x is machine translation.
Premises:
∀x (NLPtask(x) → (GenerationTask(x) ∨ UnderstandingTask(x))) ::: Natural language processing tasks can be categorized as either language generation task or language understanding task.
∀x (OutputTextSequence(x) → GenerationTask(x)) ::: If the output of a natural language processing task is a text sequence, then it is a language generation task.
MachineTranslation(machineTranslation) ∧ NLPtask(machineTranslation) ∧ OutputTextSequence(machineTranslation) ::: Machine translation is a natural language processing task. The output of machine translation is a text sequence.
Conclusion:
¬UnderstandingTask(machineTranslation) ::: Machine translation is a language understanding task.
